fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 7% of Non-Recommerce Revenue and 4% of Recommerce Revenue (where "Recommerce Revenue" = Gross Sales from sale of pre-owned mobile/electronic devices; "Non-Recommerce Revenue" = all other Gross Sales). Advertising Fee is up to 2% of Gross Sales when an Advertising Fund is established; amount determined by franchisor. Technology and Customer Support Fee is 1% of Gross Sales. National Account Administrative Fee is up to 5% of Gross Sales from National Account services. Internet Referral Source Fee is currently none but may be up to 5% of Gross Sales from Internet Referral Sources. Dispatch Fee is currently $0.75 per dispatch. Referral Commission will not exceed 10% of Total Ticket Price from Referred Customers. All fees due at end of each Accounting Period (calendar month) or at time of transaction for certain National Accounts.
raw_excerpt:
Continuing Royalty | 7% of Non-Recommerce Revenue; and 4% of Recommerce Revenue | Due at end of each Accounting Period or at payment if an administered National Account. See Note 2.
Advertising Fee | Up to 2% of Gross Sales when we establish an Advertising Fund | Same as Continuing Royalty | When we establish an Advertising Fund, you will be required to pay an Advertising Fee each Accounting Period. We determine the amount of the fee, but it will not exceed 2% of Gross Sales. The Advertising Fee will be in addition to the amounts that you must spend on local advertising.
Dispatch Fee | Our costs and expenses (Currently, $0.75 per dispatch) | Same as Continuing Royalty
National Account Administrative Fee | Up to 5% of Gross Sales from services to National Accounts | Same as Continuing Royalty
Internet Referral Source Fee | None currently; Up to 5% of Gross Sales from services to customers from Internet Referral Sources. | As we determine
Referral Commission | Set by Franchisor, but will not exceed 10% of Total Ticket Price received from Referred Customers | On demand
Technology and Customer Support Fee | 1% of Gross Sales | Same as Continuing Royalty
